name: Blitzcrank
title: The Great Steam Golem

passive.name: Mana Barrier

description.normalized: Blitzcrank gains a shield that absorbs 90 ( 30% Mana) damage for 10 seconds upon falling below 35% Health.

passive.rawParsedText: Blitzcrank gains a shield that absorbs 90 ( 30% Mana) damage for 10 seconds upon falling below 35% Health.

q.name: Rocket Grab

description.normalized: Blitzcrank fires his right hand to deal 110 / 175 / 240 / 305 (+100% AP) magic damage and pull the target back to Blitzcrank.

q.rawParsedText: Blitzcrank fires his right hand to deal 110 / 175 / 240 / 305 (+100% AP) magic damage and pull the target back to Blitzcrank.

w.name: Overdrive

description.normalized: Gains 35% / 40% / 45% / 50% to 10% decaying Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. Blitzcrank may reactivate Overdrive to gain 140% / 150% / 160% / 170% decaying Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds. When Overdrive ends, Blitzcrank is slowed by 33% for 1 second. This is increased to 99% for 1 seconds if Overdrive was recast.

w.rawParsedText:
Gains 35% / 40% / 45% / 50% to 10% decaying Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.

When Overdrive ends, Blitzcrank is slowed by 33% for 1 second. This is increased to 99% for 1 seconds if Overdrive was recast.

e.name: Power Fist

description.normalized: Empowers his next attack to crtically strike for 105 (180% / 200% / 220% / 240% AD) physical damage and knock up the target.

e.rawParsedText: Empowers his next attack to crtically strike for 105 (180% / 200% / 220% / 240% AD) physical damage and knock up the target.

r.name: Static Field

description.normalized: Passive: While Static Field is off cooldown, attacks mark enemies to deal 40 / 80 / 120 (+15% AP) magic damage after 1 second. Active: Deals 275 / 400 / 525 (+80% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and silences them for 0.5 seconds.
